name: Shaonü, Yi Chang Yu
source:
After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914410/A_Girl_A_Rain/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
推开门之后，又或许是在推门之前，世界已然变成了另一副模样。你能够逃离这场滂沱大雨吗？还是说，你会选择留下来……？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914410/A_Girl_A_Rain/]Steam[/url]]
